profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at WarnerBros Discovery
profile.summary:
I have a passion for process improvement and automating away drudgery. My deep background in communication means that I can meet stakeholders where they live and collaborate for great outcomes.

I love learning new tools and technologies. I ask questions constantly. I'm not afraid to say that I don't know the answer, that I don't understand, or that I need more information...and I expect others I work with to feel safe in doing the same. 

When I'm not in the office I'm making something with my hands, walking with my dog, reading, playing tabletop RPGs, or out in my kayak. 

Specialties: Operational Efficiency | Agile Methodologies | Workflow Automation | User Education

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description: Established process and scheduling in a brand-new startup, assisting the founders with any and all needed activities. Researched and selected tools, purchased domains, negotiated contracts, managed app stores, coordinated with legal counsel, and released code. Created metrics tracking plans and reporting dashboards. Evolved process as resources, priorities, and features changed from prototype through two major versions.
positions.insights: Skills: Operational Efficiency · Confluence · Workflow Automation · Agile Methodologies · Git · JIRA · Bitbucket · Balsamiq · Scrum

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description: Leader in a scaled Agile framework for RealPlayer: Scrum Master for the team who reworked underlying database technology while also Product Owner for the team who created a new user interface. Managed integrated product backlog for four teams, created functional specifications, ensured user stories were complete and ready to implement, removed impediments, and conducted scrum ceremonies. Represented PC teams in scrum of scrums that included cloud infrastructure, web, and mobile product components.
positions.insights: Skills: Operational Efficiency · Confluence · Agile Methodologies · HTML · JIRA · Balsamiq · XML · Scrum
